Page 39 Cont.
July 8 Mrs. Marg. Stenhouse 65 - Methodist - Very serious domestic Trouble - Husband not doing right.
Thanks - Virg. Beaufait - 15 - very threatening case of strept throat ... 4 weeks in bed. Mother phones May 22nd to Enroll her in Ser. Mass As'n. Same day abcess broke, fever gone and operation forgotten. Dr. Astonished - Deo Gr.
Page 40 July 13 Darlene O'Connor - 22 mo. - cut finger. .. in lawn mower - los of fin- ger feared.
Mrs. Romain Shanor - methodist - 47 - inward Arthritis ... Drs say they can do nothing. Enrolled To-day.
Mrs. Mary Painter - 59 - Womb cancer threatened. .. .
14 George M. Seugstock - 17 mo. in Childrens' Hospital - fell out of high-chair four weeks to-morrow - on head; has never gained con- sciousness. Enrolls. 20th - Father promises more frequent Com- munion. 3-4 times annually.
Geo Burkhardt - 55 - Port Huron - Cancer of throat .... had very bad spells recently ... finally asked to join Ser. Mass Assoc'n and soon after baptized. Now asks for prayers for recovery or grace of Happy death.
17 Evelyn Louise Faulkes - 3 - Episcopelian - hurt at bath. Enrolled
18 Gloria Oliver - 4 - prayed for last week - Eye quite improved - already opened. To-day start a "Fam. Perpetual Enrollment"
20 Marg. Ryan - 1261 Penn. Ave. - Mu 3622 - has house to sell .... in Lincoln
Page 41 July 21 Anna Pacholski - 42 - Operation bladder tomorrow ...
Donna Gering - 29 - Lutheran - nerveous Epyleptic ...
Raphael Goggin of Bernard, Iowa - 29 - had serious operation. ... glands became poisoned went to Eyes - Almost total blindness. Drs say he'll never see.
25 Patricia Burke - 10 - in Oct. Brain tuomer. Operated on last Janu- ary - has never gained consciousness - now 8 months.
